raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-MAR-SecondIdentityTargetingSocialProtection",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Recurrent climate-related shocks such as severe droughts and rainfall volatility threaten rural livelihoods and economic stability.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Utilize adaptive Social Registry and National Population Registry systems to rapidly identify affected households and deliver targeted shock-responsive assistance.",
      "evidence": "climate-related shocks, primarily droughts, represent significant risks to the Moroccan economy."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Informal sector workers may resist enrolling in the National Population Registry due to fears of tax exposure.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct targeted outreach campaigns clarifying data protection safeguards and emphasizing social protection benefits.",
      "evidence": "workers in the informal sector, are wary of providing their information to the government due to perceived risks of making them susceptible to taxation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Non-salaried workers experience income cyclicality, leading to high default rates on mandatory health insurance contributions.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate dynamic welfare evaluation tools in the Social Registry to maintain social protection coverage during income disruptions.",
      "evidence": "less than 15 percent of non-salaried workers are paying their contribution and benefit from coverage against health-related risks."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Vulnerable, disabled, or geographically isolated individuals risk exclusion from registration due to communication or physical accessibility barriers.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy mobile units, satellite communication technology, and local Citizen Service Centers alongside an inclusive Stakeholder Engagement Plan.",
      "evidence": "Potential negative social impacts from project activities are mainly related to the exclusion of some vulnerable groups due to inefficient or inadequate public communication"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Processing extensive biographic and biometric personal data creates potential data privacy, security, and unauthorized disclosure risks.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply privacy-by-design principles, enforce strict compliance with national Law 09-08, and provide data security training for system operators.",
      "evidence": "Potential negative social impacts from project activities are mainly related to... data protection issues."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Capacity constraints within the Ministry of Interior may delay operationalizing the National Registry Agency and transferring operational management.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide dedicated institutional capacity building, recruit key technical leadership, and execute formal transition operational manuals.",
      "evidence": "This rapid expansion has strained the government’s and the MoI’s capacity to take steps in operationalizing the NRA."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Social protection intake and benefit targeting processes may be vulnerable to system error, fraud, and corruption.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop and deploy an end-to-end error, fraud, and corruption monitoring system integrated with biometric deduplication and database cross-checks.",
      "evidence": "design and develop an end-to-end Error, Fraud, and Corruption (EFC) monitoring system and EFC mitigation strategy"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Deployment and maintenance of electronic hardware and mobile equipment across regions may lead to improper e-waste disposal.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement formal e-waste management procedures in compliance with Ministry of Interior asset disposal protocols.",
      "evidence": "Risks associated with the use of electronic devices (such as mobile units) include the potential generation of e-waste and its improper disposal."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Reliance on spreadsheets and manual national budget software data extraction may introduce quality and timeliness issues in financial reporting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Procure and operationalize customized accounting software to automate project financial reporting and IFR generation.",
      "evidence": "the use of a spreadsheet “Excel” and data extracted from the national budget execution software may lead to some challenges"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Using shared budget lines across multiple World Bank financed projects risks duplicate claiming of Eligible Expenditure Program costs.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish distinct, dedicated budget sub-codes within the Ministry of Interior budget for all performance-based condition activities.",
      "evidence": "risk of duplication or overlap due to the use of the same budget line “AMO-TADAMON” to justify expenditure... on programs already financed"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Flaws in the Proxy-Means Test scoring formula may generate high targeting error rates, causing inclusion and exclusion errors.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Re-evaluate and update the intake questionnaire and scoring formula using empirical household expenditure survey data.",
      "evidence": "develop a strategy to reduce potential exclusion and inclusion errors"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Infrastructure and network deficits across remote Civil Registry Offices (BECs) may hamper real-time birth and death data exchange with the NPR.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade IT hardware, software, and connectivity across all 2,200 local Civil Registry Offices nationwide.",
      "evidence": "all the 2,200 Civil Registry Offices (Bureau d’Etat Civil, BEC) nationwide, some of which are in very isolated areas and require substantial investments"
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Recurrent climate-related shocks such as severe droughts and rainfall volatility threaten rural livelihoods and economic stability.
risks.mitigation: Utilize adaptive Social Registry and National Population Registry systems to rapidly identify affected households and deliver targeted shock-responsive assistance.
risks.evidence: climate-related shocks, primarily droughts, represent significant risks to the Moroccan economy.

risks.description: Informal sector workers may resist enrolling in the National Population Registry due to fears of tax exposure.
risks.mitigation: Conduct targeted outreach campaigns clarifying data protection safeguards and emphasizing social protection benefits.
risks.evidence: workers in the informal sector, are wary of providing their information to the government due to perceived risks of making them susceptible to taxation.

risks.description: Non-salaried workers experience income cyclicality, leading to high default rates on mandatory health insurance contributions.
risks.mitigation: Incorporate dynamic welfare evaluation tools in the Social Registry to maintain social protection coverage during income disruptions.
risks.evidence: less than 15 percent of non-salaried workers are paying their contribution and benefit from coverage against health-related risks.

risks.description: Vulnerable, disabled, or geographically isolated individuals risk exclusion from registration due to communication or physical accessibility barriers.
risks.mitigation: Deploy mobile units, satellite communication technology, and local Citizen Service Centers alongside an inclusive Stakeholder Engagement Plan.
risks.evidence: Potential negative social impacts from project activities are mainly related to the exclusion of some vulnerable groups due to inefficient or inadequate public communication

risks.description: Processing extensive biographic and biometric personal data creates potential data privacy, security, and unauthorized disclosure risks.
risks.mitigation: Apply privacy-by-design principles, enforce strict compliance with national Law 09-08, and provide data security training for system operators.
risks.evidence: Potential negative social impacts from project activities are mainly related to... data protection issues.

risks.description: Capacity constraints within the Ministry of Interior may delay operationalizing the National Registry Agency and transferring operational management.
risks.mitigation: Provide dedicated institutional capacity building, recruit key technical leadership, and execute formal transition operational manuals.
risks.evidence: This rapid expansion has strained the government’s and the MoI’s capacity to take steps in operationalizing the NRA.

risks.description: Social protection intake and benefit targeting processes may be vulnerable to system error, fraud, and corruption.
risks.mitigation: Develop and deploy an end-to-end error, fraud, and corruption monitoring system integrated with biometric deduplication and database cross-checks.
risks.evidence: design and develop an end-to-end Error, Fraud, and Corruption (EFC) monitoring system and EFC mitigation strategy

risks.description: Deployment and maintenance of electronic hardware and mobile equipment across regions may lead to improper e-waste disposal.
risks.mitigation: Implement formal e-waste management procedures in compliance with Ministry of Interior asset disposal protocols.
risks.evidence: Risks associated with the use of electronic devices (such as mobile units) include the potential generation of e-waste and its improper disposal.

risks.description: Reliance on spreadsheets and manual national budget software data extraction may introduce quality and timeliness issues in financial reporting.
risks.mitigation: Procure and operationalize customized accounting software to automate project financial reporting and IFR generation.
risks.evidence: the use of a spreadsheet “Excel” and data extracted from the national budget execution software may lead to some challenges

risks.description: Using shared budget lines across multiple World Bank financed projects risks duplicate claiming of Eligible Expenditure Program costs.
risks.mitigation: Establish distinct, dedicated budget sub-codes within the Ministry of Interior budget for all performance-based condition activities.
risks.evidence: risk of duplication or overlap due to the use of the same budget line “AMO-TADAMON” to justify expenditure... on programs already financed

risks.description: Flaws in the Proxy-Means Test scoring formula may generate high targeting error rates, causing inclusion and exclusion errors.
risks.mitigation: Re-evaluate and update the intake questionnaire and scoring formula using empirical household expenditure survey data.
risks.evidence: develop a strategy to reduce potential exclusion and inclusion errors

risks.description: Infrastructure and network deficits across remote Civil Registry Offices (BECs) may hamper real-time birth and death data exchange with the NPR.
risks.mitigation: Upgrade IT hardware, software, and connectivity across all 2,200 local Civil Registry Offices nationwide.
risks.evidence: all the 2,200 Civil Registry Offices (Bureau d’Etat Civil, BEC) nationwide, some of which are in very isolated areas and require substantial investments
